summary: BioHarvest Sciences filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Canadian Material Change Report dated September 15, 2026, disclosing a cross-border dual listing rather than a special situation. The registrant announced on September 3, 2026 its intent to register all outstanding common shares on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, and trading began September 8, 2026 alongside its existing Nasdaq Capital Market listing under symbol BHST. Registration covers 22,667,842 outstanding shares, up to 4,516,021 shares under the equity incentive plan, and 610,742 warrant shares. No price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation applies; all future EDGAR filings will simultaneously post to MAGNA. Watch liquidity split and Israeli disclosure cadence.
